channel.title: Nish's Daily Reads
channel.description: A daily read for a founder: AI, product ideas, and demand signals.

description.p: I opened six strong primary or near-primary sources from 232 candidates. The clearest signal was practical AI: local models are getting small enough to run on devices, while businesses are learning to control AI costs and permissions. I dropped the rest for weak proof, repetition, or engineering detail without a founder-level consequence.

ol.li: Muse Glimmer puts a 30B agent on a consumer GPU — Meta AI Research
Needle 2 makes device AI a 14 MB product component — Cactus Compute
Claude Code will default to fewer permission prompts — TechCrunch
OpenAI prices heavier Business seats at $125 — OpenAI
Corma raises $60M to build an AI cyber-defense workforce — Fortune
World Train Map redraws 1,093 routes from better data — World Train Map
